records.text: A Turning Point USA donor handler promised Erika Kirk that he would lead fundraising for the memorial service.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep Wjul6YV6izo)

appearances.snippet: He's promised Erika that he will run point on raising money to cover the memorial service,

verification.notes: Public reporting confirms extensive TPUSA fundraising after Charlie Kirk's death, but live searches found no independent evidence that the unnamed donor handler made this specific promise to Erika Kirk or was assigned to lead memorial fundraising.

conveyance.original_source: Text message shown by the email source

records.text: The memorial service for Charlie Kirk was expected to cost approximately $6 million.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep Wjul6YV6izo)

appearances.snippet: which is going to cost approximately $6 million.

verification.notes: Public records document at least USD 493,000 in Glendale services and reporting identifies a separate USD 2.6 million federal perimeter-security contract, while stadium and organizer costs remain undisclosed. These figures do not verify the anonymous contemporaneous estimate that the memorial itself was expected to cost approximately USD 6 million.

conveyance.original_source: Text message shown by the email source

records.text: Apparently, Donald Trump had to become personally involved to secure State Farm Stadium for Charlie Kirk's memorial.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep Wjul6YV6izo)

appearances.snippet: Apparently, ... Trump had to get personally involved to secure the Cardinal Stadium.

verification.notes: Trump attended the memorial and the White House supported security and commemoration, but current searches found no reliable source showing that Trump personally intervened in the private stadium booking. The venue operator does not release private contract details.

conveyance.original_source: Text message shown by the email source

records.text: A large and lucrative RV show was scheduled at State Farm Stadium during the weekend of Charlie Kirk's memorial.
records.speaker: Anonymous Source #3 (Ep Wjul6YV6izo)

appearances.snippet: which is planning to host a large and lucrative RV show this weekend.

verification.notes: Associated Press reporting before the memorial states the Arizona Cardinals were away that Sunday and that this left State Farm Stadium available for short-notice rental. Searches found no contemporaneous listing, cancellation notice, ticket record, or credible report of a displaced RV show at the stadium that weekend.

sources.title: What to know about State Farm Stadium, the venue hosting Charlie Kirk's memorial service Sunday - Associated Press
sources.relevance: Reports the Cardinals were away and that this left the stadium available for rental on short notice, contradicting a displaced RV show.
